Communal_Observance: Alternating antiphonal psalmody and beacon tending
Ink grinding, chronicle reading, and Synod docket review
Allotment of tools, reed pens, and daily labor pairs
Shared salt & barley meal; wax-tablet grievances laid by bowl
Foundry bells toll; wax grievances read aloud before elders
Reliquaries locked; lamps lowered to single sanctuary wick
Hearth fires banked; salt withheld from evening broth
Old parchment trimmings burned to grind fresh lampblack ink
Standard agricultural, foundry, and scriptorium rotation
